method: Three sequential before/experiment/restored processes run the same serializer workload. Each creates Tiny seed74 four-faction Epic origins and replaces only their known-land input with4096 schema-valid records spread over four1024-cell dictionaries. These are deliberate projection inputs, not globally validated campaigns. Each mode performs10 warmups followed by60 timed serializeGame calls; reported medians use sorted index30, p95 index57. All other simulation/save code remains unchanged between these three runs.
tupleConstruction: duplicates: tuple=index%12, settlementId=null; unique: tuple=index, settlementId='settlement.'+(tuple+1); overflow: tuple=index%1100 with the same settlementId construction. Each has biome=tuple%12, factionId=turnOwnerId, improvementId=null for odd tuples and improvement.quarry for even tuples.
experiment: A call-local1024-entry tuple cache replaced only knownLandSchema leaves through a Zod transform. All original record keys, strict outer schema, plain-record guards and leaf parsing on cache misses remained. Hits required schema-derived exact ordinary enumerable data properties and exact typed primitive values; accessors/unusual shapes fell back to the original parser. No persistent cache existed.
retention: Benchmark JSON values retained from tool output; this file does not claim byte-for-byte raw stdout retention.

before.note: Synthetic schema-valid known-memory projections for serializer validation cost; not a globally valid campaign or an isolated game benchmark.

experiment.note: Synthetic schema-valid known-memory projections for serializer validation cost; not a globally valid campaign or an isolated game benchmark.

restored.note: Synthetic schema-valid known-memory projections for serializer validation cost; not a globally valid campaign or an isolated game benchmark.

decision: Reject. The attempted cache is slower in all three modes, including highly repetitive inputs; restored timings return close to the original baseline. Cache eligibility, transform/wrapper and lookup overhead outweigh avoided parsing in this implementation. All three serialized byte lengths and SHA256 values match across all runs. No cache helper, schema change or experiment-only test remains in production/source.
verification: After restoring the original parser, the existing canonical-land and serialization-performance suites pass32 tests; scoped save lint passes. This is not evidence that the unchanged60-second Epic integration gate passes.
